A3: CI/CD Pipeline with GitHub Actions
Patrick Augusto — Universitat de Lleida, 2025–2026

Workflow   | File     | Trigger                              | Jobs
-----------|----------|--------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------
CI         | ci.yml   | push, pull_request                   | Lint → Test → Build
CD         | cd.yml   | push (main/develop), manual dispatch | Build → Deploy (Hosting, Functions, Firestore, Storage)
